subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload RPC/UI, and what storage, validation, auth, and identity-precedence policy should it use?
rationale: The requested flow is useful, but it crosses a new authenticated file-upload and workspace-write boundary, so automation should not choose the security model or precedence policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded upload path
options.body: Add a narrow `operator.admin` upload flow that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves the existing read-only avatar route protections.

options.title: Keep existing identity paths
options.body: Continue supporting manual `IDENTITY.md`, config/CLI avatar strings, and browser-local Quick Settings overrides while avoiding server-side upload risk for now.

options.title: Defer to broader identity management
options.body: Keep this issue open or fold it into a sponsored Control UI identity-management design before adding a one-off upload contract.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload path
recommendation.body: Add a narrow `operator.admin` upload flow that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and preserves the existing read-only avatar route protections.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history signal for the avatar route, avatar policy hardening, and the original avatar support merge.
